card, or bounded help.

state: a merged PR may already have changed `main` since the handoff was written.

mid-task, so asking "Want me to…?" blocks the work. When the handoff queue, the user, or your own
recommendation names the next action, do it and report in the past tense. Stop only for destructive
actions or genuine scope changes the user must decide, and give one recommendation, not a menu. One
standing exception with a reason: changes to the agent system itself (agent definitions, skills,
settings, hooks, launchers, rules) alter every future session, so they need the user's present-tense
go in this conversation. Before ending a turn, check your last paragraph: if it is a plan, a
question, or a promise about work not yet done, do that work now.

The user's request — or the plan they approved — sets the scope, and the scope is the deliverable.
Make routine judgment calls yourself; check in only when different readings would lead to
materially different work. If you see a real problem with the task as specified, say so in a
sentence and keep building under stated assumptions; if part of the task is blocked, finish every

+### Claude headless permissions
+
+Ordinary Claude `read-only` dispatches use `dontAsk` with read/search tools,

+receive PreToolUse guards generated from
+`agents_extensions/shared/settings.json`, with hook commands resolved to the

+tools. The guards stop recognized direct primary-checkout writes while allowing
+worktree writes; arbitrary interpreter writes remain a known parser limit.

+"""Command and deployed-hook coverage for headless Claude workers."""
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from scripts.agent_runtime.adapters.claude import REVIEWER_PERMISSION_PROFILE, ClaudeAdapter
+from scripts.guardrails.worktree_containment import resolve_main_root
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["read-only", "workspace-write", "danger"])
+def test_claude_worker_modes_install_guards(mode: str, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    plan = ClaudeAdapter().build_invocation(
+        prompt="inspect", mode=mode, cwd=tmp_path, model=None,
+        task_id=None, session_id=None, tool_config=None,
+    )
+    assert "--bare" not in plan.cmd
+    settings = json.loads(plan.cmd[plan.cmd.index("--settings") + 1])
+    hooks = settings["hooks"]["PreToolUse"]
+    assert {"Bash", "Write|Edit|MultiEdit"} <= {group["matcher"] for group in hooks}
+    commands = [hook["command"] for group in hooks for hook in group["hooks"]]
+    primary_hooks = resolve_main_root(Path(__file__)) / ".claude/hooks"
+    for name in (
+        "guard-primary-checkout-write.py", "guard-secret-print.py",
+        "guard-pr-merge.py", "guard-branch-switch-in-main.py",
+        "guard-admin-merge.py", "enforce-venv.sh", "heal-core-bare.py",
+    ):
+        assert str(primary_hooks / name) in commands
+    assert all(Path(command).is_file() for command in commands)
+
+    if mode == "read-only":
+        assert plan.cmd[plan.cmd.index("--permission-mode") + 1] == "dontAsk"
+        assert set(REVIEWER_PERMISSION_PROFILE["allow"]) <= set(
+            plan.cmd[plan.cmd.index("--allowedTools") + 1].split(",")
+        )
+        assert set(REVIEWER_PERMISSION_PROFILE["deny"]) == set(
+            plan.cmd[plan.cmd.index("--disallowedTools") + 1].split(",")
+        )
+    else:
+        assert "--permission-mode" not in plan.cmd
+        assert "--disallowedTools" not in plan.cmd
+    assert ("--dangerously-skip-permissions" in plan.cmd) is (mode == "danger")
+
+
+def test_discussion_readonly_keeps_separate_permissions(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    plan = ClaudeAdapter().build_invocation(
+        prompt="inspect", mode="read-only", cwd=tmp_path, model=None,
+        task_id=None, session_id=None, tool_config={"discussion_readonly": True},
+    )
+    assert "--settings" in plan.cmd
+    assert "--permission-mode" not in plan.cmd
+    assert "--disallowedTools" not in plan.cmd
+    assert plan.cmd[plan.cmd.index("--tools") + 1] == "Read,Grep,Glob,LS"
+
+
+def test_review_isolation_keeps_separate_permissions(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    from scripts.agent_runtime.adapters import claude
+    from scripts.review import isolation
+
+    mcp = tmp_path / "empty.json"
+    mcp.write_text('{"mcpServers":{}}\n', encoding="utf-8")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(isolation, "validated_review_write_root", lambda _: tmp_path)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(claude, "_isolated_review_response_schema", lambda _: "{}")
+    plan = ClaudeAdapter().build_invocation(
+        prompt="inspect", mode="read-only", cwd=tmp_path, model=None,
+        task_id=None, session_id=None,
+        tool_config={
+            "review_isolation": True, "review_engine_binary": "/bin/true",
+            "strict_mcp_config": True, "mcp_config_path": str(mcp),
+            "setting_sources": "", "allowed_tools": "",
+        },
+    )
+    assert "--settings" not in plan.cmd
+    assert "--safe-mode" in plan.cmd
+    assert "--permission-mode" not in plan.cmd
+    assert "--disallowedTools" not in plan.cmd
+    assert plan.cmd[plan.cmd.index("--tools") + 1] == ""
+
+
+def test_sources_allowance_only_when_mcp_config_is_passed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    def plan(config: dict) -> list[str]:
+        return ClaudeAdapter().build_invocation(
+            prompt="inspect", mode="read-only", cwd=tmp_path, model=None,
+            task_id=None, session_id=None, tool_config=config,
+        ).cmd
+
+    ordinary = plan({})
+    with_mcp = plan({"mcp_config_path": "/tmp/sources.json"})
+    assert "mcp__sources__*" not in ordinary[ordinary.index("--allowedTools") + 1]
+    assert "mcp__sources__*" in with_mcp[with_mcp.index("--allowedTools") + 1]
+    assert with_mcp.count("--allowedTools") == 1

44	  determine it. The runner's mtime poller catches Claude writing
45	  progress when stdout is buffered or quiet.

116	def _worker_guard_settings() -> str:
117	    """Build hook settings from tracked sources with deployed primary paths."""
118	    from scripts.guardrails.worktree_containment import resolve_main_root
119	
120	    source_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
121	    primary_root = resolve_main_root(source_root)
122	    source = json.loads((source_root / "agents_extensions/shared/settings.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
123	    groups = []
124	    prefix = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/"
125	    for group in source["hooks"]["PreToolUse"]:
126	        hooks = []
127	        for hook in group["hooks"]:
128	            command = hook.get("command", "")
129	            if not command.startswith(prefix):
130	                continue
131	            deployed = primary_root / ".claude/hooks" / command.removeprefix(prefix)
132	            if not deployed.is_file():
133	                raise RuntimeError(f"Claude worker guard unavailable: {deployed}")
134	            hooks.append({**hook, "command": str(deployed)})
135	        if hooks:
136	            groups.append({"matcher": group["matcher"], "hooks": hooks})
137	    if not groups:
138	        raise RuntimeError("Claude worker PreToolUse guards unavailable")
139	    return json.dumps({"hooks": {"PreToolUse": groups}}, separators=(",", ":"))

169	def _probe_claude_cli_version(cmd_prefix: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
170	    """Probe ``claude --version`` once per binary prefix for this process."""
171	    try:
172	        from utils.claude_version import _parse_claude_semver
173	    except ImportError:
174	        return None
175	
176	    try:
177	        result = subprocess.run(
178	            [*cmd_prefix, "--version"],
179	            capture_output=True,
180	            text=True,
181	            timeout=5,
182	            check=False,

188	    return _parse_claude_semver(combined)

206	def _default_claude_bin() -> str | None:
207	    """Resolve the native ``claude`` binary: PATH first, then the default
208	    install target ``~/.local/bin/claude`` (present even when the caller's
209	    PATH omits it — mirrors ai_agent_bridge._config and start-claude.sh:33).
210	    Returns None when no native install exists. (deepseek review-4881
211	    follow-up on #4875.)"""
212	    found = shutil.which("claude")
213	    if found:
214	        return found
215	    default = Path.home() / ".local/bin/claude"
216	    if default.is_file():
217	        return str(default)
218	    return None

221	class ClaudeAdapter:
222	    """Adapter for the ``claude`` CLI in print mode (local binary preferred)."""
223	
224	    name: str = "claude"
225	    default_model: str = "claude-sonnet-5"
226	    # Operator 2026-08-13: headless/print defaults to high when the caller
227	    # omits effort; interactive start-claude.sh keeps empty (last session).
228	    default_effort: str = "high"
229	    supported_modes: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"read-only", "workspace-write", "danger"})
230	
231	    def build_invocation(
232	        self,
233	        *,
234	        prompt: str,
235	        mode: str,
236	        cwd: Path,
237	        model: str | None,
238	        task_id: str | None,
239	        session_id: str | None,
240	        tool_config: dict | None,
241	        effort: str | None = None,
242	    ) -> InvocationPlan:
243	        """Build the Claude Code invocation.
244	
245	        ``tool_config`` keys honored:
246	            - ``is_new_session: bool`` — if True, use ``--session-id`` (new
247	              named session); if False or absent, use ``--resume`` (resume
248	              existing). Only meaningful when ``session_id`` is provided.
249	            - ``mcp_config_path: str`` — path to .mcp.json for tool restrictions
250	            - ``allowed_tools: str`` — comma-separated list passed to --allowedTools
251	            - ``output_format: str`` — defaults to "stream-json" so tool
252	              calls can be captured from the CLI trace.
253	            - ``use_bare: bool`` — legacy option ignored for guarded workers;
254	              --bare would disable the mandatory PreToolUse hooks.
255	            - ``max_budget_usd: float`` — optional Claude Code print-mode
256	              API spend cap, emitted as ``--max-budget-usd <amount>``
257	
258	        ``effort``: optional reasoning-level string. When None, the headless
259	        lane default ``high`` is applied (operator 2026-08-13). When the
260	        probed Claude binary supports ``--effort`` (CC 2.1.98+), the flag
261	        is appended as ``--effort <level>``. Otherwise we log a warning
262	        and proceed without the flag. Claude CLI versions below 2.1.116
263	        are rejected outright due to the 2026-04-23 postmortem gate.
264	        """
265	        tc: dict[str, Any] = tool_config or {}
266	        discussion_readonly = _discussion_readonly_requested(tool_config)
267	        review_isolation = bool(tc.get("review_isolation"))
268	        review_write_root: Path | None = None
269	        if review_isolation:
270	            from scripts.review.isolation import validated_review_write_root
271	
272	            review_write_root = validated_review_write_root(tc)
273	        if discussion_readonly and mode != "read-only":
274	            raise ValueError("AB_DISCUSS_READONLY requires mode='read-only'")
275	
276	        # Command prefix — prefer the local native ``claude`` binary; ``npx``
277	        # is the fallback for machines without a native install (#4875).
278	        #
279	        # History (both flips were empirically diagnosed — check before
280	        # flipping again):
281	        # - Pre-#1684: local binary first. On 2026-05-05 that let dispatched
282	        #   runs silently drift behind the npx-managed version (local 2.1.126
283	        #   vs npx 2.1.128), so #1684 flipped to npx-first.
284	        # - #4875 (2026-07-10): the ``@anthropic-ai/claude-code`` npm package
285	        #   became a thin shim around a NATIVE installer — ``npx @latest``
286	        #   now exits rc=1 in ~8s with "Error: claude native binary not
287	        #   installed" (stdout empty, no stderr diagnostic). Every dispatched
288	        #   claude run died at spawn; last successful lane dispatch was
289	        #   2026-05-31. The native binary on PATH self-updates, so the
290	        #   #1684 version-drift concern no longer applies; the
291	        #   ``_ensure_supported_claude_cli_version`` gate below still rejects
292	        #   stale binaries (< 2.1.116) loudly.
293	        #
294	        # Callers can still override by passing
295	        # ``tool_config={"cmd_prefix": [...]}`` (preserved unchanged).
296	        cmd_prefix = tc.get("cmd_prefix")
297	        if review_isolation:
298	            trusted = tc.get("review_engine_binary")
299	            if not isinstance(trusted, str) or not Path(trusted).is_absolute():
300	                raise ValueError("ClaudeAdapter: trusted review_engine_binary required")
301	            cmd = [trusted]
302	        elif cmd_prefix:
303	            cmd = [cmd_prefix] if isinstance(cmd_prefix, str) else list(cmd_prefix)
304	        else:
305	            claude_bin = _default_claude_bin()
306	            if claude_bin:
307	                cmd = [claude_bin]
308	            elif shutil.which("npx"):
309	                cmd = ["npx", "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest"]
310	            else:
311	                raise RuntimeError(
312	                    "Cannot dispatch Claude Code: neither a `claude` binary "
313	                    "nor `npx` was found on PATH. Install the native Claude "
314	                    "CLI (https://claude.com/claude-code) or Node.js "
315	                    "(provides npx)."
316	                )
317	
318	        probe_prefix = tuple(cmd)
319	        # Review binaries are probed later, inside the verified OS sandbox.
320	        cli_version = None if review_isolation else _ensure_supported_claude_cli_version(probe_prefix)
321	
322	        cmd.append("-p")
323	        # NB: the actual prompt positional is appended at the END below, after a
324	        # `--` separator. Reason: Claude CLI uses Commander.js, which parses any
325	        # argv starting with `-`/`--` as a flag — even in positional position —
326	        # unless preceded by `--` (end-of-options marker). Channel-context
327	        # prompts from `ab discuss` start with `--- context: shared (sha256: ...)`
328	        # which Commander then treats as `unknown option '---'`. The `--`
329	        # separator makes the parser stop interpreting flags. (Bug surfaced
330	        # 2026-05-05 during the Claude+Gemini deliberation pilot.)
331	
332	        has_session = session_id is not None
333	        # --bare skips hooks, including the primary-checkout guard. Never use
334	        # it for a headless worker, even when an API key is available. Sealed
335	        # review isolation deliberately disables hooks and shell/write tools;
336	        # its OS sandbox does not mount the primary checkout's deployed hooks.
337	        if not review_isolation:
338	            cmd.extend(["--settings", _worker_guard_settings()])
339	        if review_isolation:
340	            # Exact read/search tools + empty setting sources: no write/shell
341	            # tools and no project CLAUDE.md/hooks/skills when flags are honored.
342	            cmd.append("--safe-mode")
343	            if "setting_sources" in tc:
344	                cmd.extend(["--setting-sources", str(tc.get("setting_sources") or "")])
345	            cmd.extend(["--tools", str(tc.get("allowed_tools") or "")])
346	            mcp_config_path = tc.get("mcp_config_path")
347	            if not tc.get("strict_mcp_config") or not isinstance(mcp_config_path, str):
348	                raise ValueError("ClaudeAdapter: isolated review requires strict empty MCP config")
349	            mcp_path = Path(mcp_config_path)
350	            try:
351	                mcp_resolved = mcp_path.resolve(strict=True)
352	            except OSError as exc:
353	                raise ValueError("ClaudeAdapter: invalid isolated review MCP config path") from exc
354	            if (
355	                review_write_root is None
356	                or not mcp_path.is_absolute()
357	                or not mcp_resolved.is_relative_to(review_write_root)
358	                or not mcp_path.is_file()
359	                or mcp_path.is_symlink()
360	            ):
361	                raise ValueError("ClaudeAdapter: invalid isolated review MCP config path")
362	            if mcp_resolved.read_bytes() != b'{"mcpServers":{}}\n':
363	                raise ValueError("ClaudeAdapter: isolated review MCP config is not empty")
364	            cmd.extend(["--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", str(mcp_resolved)])
365	            cmd.extend(["--json-schema", _isolated_review_response_schema(tc)])
366	
367	        # Session handling — --session-id (new) vs --resume (existing)
368	        if has_session:
369	            is_new = bool(tc.get("is_new_session", False))
370	            if is_new:
371	                cmd.extend(["--session-id", session_id])
372	            else:
373	                cmd.extend(["--resume", session_id])
374	
375	        # Model override
376	        if model:
377	            cmd.extend(["--model", model])
378	
379	        max_budget_usd = tc.get("max_budget_usd")
380	        if max_budget_usd is not None:
381	            # Claude Code only honors --max-budget-usd in print mode. This
382	            # adapter always uses -p, so the constraint is satisfied here.
383	            cmd.extend(["--max-budget-usd", f"{float(max_budget_usd):.2f}"])
384	
385	        # Effort (reasoning level) — version-gated. See #1396. Omitted effort
386	        # defaults to the headless lane default (high, operator 2026-08-13).
387	        effective_effort = effort if effort is not None else self.default_effort
388	        if not review_isolation:
389	            # ``supports_effort`` is the single patchable decision point for
390	            # --effort: tests patch it to simulate an unsupported CLI, and the
391	            # default-high lane default must ALSO omit the flag when the CLI
392	            # lacks it. To avoid a second ``claude --version`` subprocess —
393	            # which broke writer-isolation CI when tests patch runner Popen
394	            # and capture the probe as argv[0] instead of the real agent
395	            # command — seed the shared per-prefix cache from the
396	            # already-probed cli_version so the ``supports_effort`` call is a
397	            # cache hit in production. Min supported CLI is 2.1.116; --effort
398	            # landed at 2.1.98 (_EFFORT_MIN_VERSION).
399	            from utils.claude_version import remember_support, supports_effort
400	
401	            if cli_version is not None:
402	                remember_support(probe_prefix, cli_version >= _EFFORT_MIN_VERSION)
403	            effort_supported = supports_effort(probe_prefix)
404	            if effort_supported:
405	                cmd.extend(["--effort", effective_effort])
406	            else:
407	                _logger.warning(
408	                    "Claude CLI at %s does not support --effort; ignoring effort=%r and using CLI default (#1396)",
409	                    probe_prefix,
410	                    effective_effort,
411	                )
412	
413	        output_schema = load_output_schema(tc)
414	        if output_schema is not None:
415	            if review_isolation:
416	                raise ValueError("ClaudeAdapter: caller output schema conflicts with isolated review schema")
417	            cmd.extend(["--json-schema", json.dumps(output_schema, separators=(",", ":"))])
418	
419	        # Output format
420	        output_format = str(tc.get("output_format", "stream-json"))
421	        if output_format != "stream-json":
422	            raise ValueError(
423	                "ClaudeAdapter requires tool_config output_format='stream-json' "
424	                "so tool-call trace parsing fails closed instead of degrading "
425	                "to text output"
426	            )
427	        cmd.extend(["--output-format", output_format])
428	        cmd.append("--verbose")
429	
430	        if discussion_readonly:
431	            cmd.extend(["--tools", "Read,Grep,Glob,LS"])
432	
433	        requested_agent = tc.get("agent")
434	        if requested_agent:
435	            if cli_version and cli_version < _AGENT_FLAG_MIN_VERSION:
436	                raise RuntimeError(
437	                    f"Claude CLI < 2.1.119 does not support --agent for print-mode subprocesses; got {cli_version!r}."
438	                )
439	            cmd.extend(["--agent", str(requested_agent)])
440	
441	        # Mode-specific flags
442	        if mode == "danger":
443	            cmd.append("--dangerously-skip-permissions")
444	        elif mode == "read-only" and not discussion_readonly and not review_isolation:
445	            profile = REVIEWER_PERMISSION_PROFILE
446	            cmd.extend(["--permission-mode", profile["mode"]])
447	            granted = [*profile["allow"]]
448	            if tc.get("mcp_config_path"):
449	                granted.extend(profile["mcp_allow"])
450	            if tc.get("allowed_tools"):
451	                granted.extend(str(tc["allowed_tools"]).split(","))
452	            cmd.extend(["--allowedTools", ",".join(dict.fromkeys(granted))])
453	            cmd.extend(["--disallowedTools", ",".join(profile["deny"])])
454	
455	        # MCP tool restrictions (pipeline reviewers)
456	        mcp_config_path = tc.get("mcp_config_path")
457	        allowed_tools = tc.get("allowed_tools")
458	        if tc.get("strict_mcp_config") and mcp_config_path and not review_isolation:
459	            cmd.extend(["--strict-mcp-config", "--mcp-config", str(mcp_config_path)])
460	            if allowed_tools and not (mode == "read-only" and not discussion_readonly):
461	                cmd.extend(["--allowedTools", allowed_tools])
462	        elif mcp_config_path and allowed_tools and not review_isolation:
463	            cmd.extend(["--mcp-config", str(mcp_config_path)])
464	            if mode != "read-only" or discussion_readonly:
465	                cmd.extend(["--allowedTools", allowed_tools])
466	        elif mcp_config_path and not review_isolation:
467	            cmd.extend(["--mcp-config", str(mcp_config_path)])
468	
469	        # Cache-warmth optimization (CC 2.1.98+)
470	        if cli_version and cli_version >= _EFFORT_MIN_VERSION:
471	            cmd.append("--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections")
472	
473	        # Large sealed review dossiers and multi-lesson coherence prompts can
474	        # exceed execve ARG_MAX (Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN = 128KB). Claude print
475	        # mode accepts text on stdin, so the isolation path and large prompts
476	        # never place review evidence in argv. Ordinary calls retain positional.
477	        use_stdin = review_isolation or len(prompt.encode("utf-8")) >= 100_000
478	        if not use_stdin:
479	            # Prompt positional MUST be last, preceded by `--` end-of-options marker.
480	            # See comment near `cmd.append("-p")` above for the Commander.js rationale.
481	            cmd.extend(["--", prompt])
482	
483	        return InvocationPlan(
484	            cmd=cmd,
485	            cwd=cwd,
486	            stdin_payload=prompt if use_stdin else "",
487	            output_file=None,
488	            env_overrides={"AB_DISCUSS_READONLY": "1"} if discussion_readonly else {},
489	            liveness_paths=self._resolve_liveness_paths(cwd),
490	            metadata={
491	                **schema_metadata(output_schema),
492	                **({"claude_home": str(review_write_root / "home")} if review_write_root is not None else {}),
493	            },
494	        )

496	    def parse_response(
497	        self,
498	        *,
499	        stdout: str,
500	        stderr: str,
501	        returncode: int,
502	        output_file: Path | None,
503	        plan: InvocationPlan | None = None,
504	        call_start_time: float | None = None,
505	    ) -> ParseResult:
506	        """Parse Claude CLI output into a ParseResult.
507	
508	        Claude Code writes the response to stdout. On success, stdout is
509	        the clean output; on failure, stderr carries the diagnostic.
510	        """
511	        _ = output_file  # Unused — Claude doesn't use -o file
512	        _ = call_start_time
513	
514	        events = parse_json_events(stdout, source="claude", logger=_logger)
515	        tool_calls = normalize_tool_calls(events)
516	        stream_response = _extract_stream_json_response(events)
517	        effective_stdout = stream_response if events else stdout.strip()
518	
519	        session_id: str | None = None
520	        sid_match = _SESSION_ID_RE.search(stdout or "")
521	        if sid_match:
522	            session_id = sid_match.group(1)
523	        for event in events:
524	            sid = event.get("session_id") or event.get("sessionId")
525	            if isinstance(sid, str) and sid:
526	                session_id = sid
527	                break
528	
529	        # Session JSONL is authoritative when stream-json stdout drops tool rows
530	        # (measured: subscription tooled bakeoff cells with MCP, 2026-07-08).
531	        if plan is not None and plan.cwd is not None and session_id:
532	            raw_home = plan.metadata.get("claude_home")
533	            claude_home = Path(raw_home) if isinstance(raw_home, str) else None
534	            session_path = _claude_session_jsonl_path(
535	                plan.cwd,
536	                session_id,
537	                home=claude_home,
538	            )
539	            if session_path is not None:
